blacklist.title: Private blacklist
blacklist.intro: People and Teams you chose not to be paired with again. Only you can see this list.
blacklist.double_blind: The other party is never informed and can never find out they are on your blacklist.
blacklist.offer_title_grace: Do not pair me with them again?
blacklist.offer_title_no_show: Do not pair me with them again?
blacklist.offer_body: You can add this counterpart to your private blacklist. PITCALL will stop pairing you in future matches.
blacklist.offer_confirm: Add this counterpart to your private blacklist? They will never be informed, and PITCALL will stop pairing you in future matches.
blacklist.add_failed: Could not add to your blacklist
blacklist.remove_confirm: Remove this block? You may be paired with this counterpart again in future matches.
